name: Lustful Waves
source:
In Burbank CA, the Media Capital of the World, you, a young fashion designer, are looking for your place under the sun, but in vain! When an exceptional opportunity comes your way, make sure to play smart in order to finally start living your life to the fullest!

[From in-app]
translation:
在被誉为“世界媒体之都”的加利福尼亚州伯班克，你这位年轻的服装设计师一直努力寻找属于自己的一席之地，却始终徒劳无功！当一个千载难逢的机会来到眼前，务必机灵应对，好让自己终于能够尽情生活！

[摘自应用内介绍]
